entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: cerberus PR #2624 (finding 10) deduped the identical `if b.ReturnBool { return nil, fmt.Errorf(...) }` guard three composer families used to repeat inline — scalar() (lowerScalarArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp), sort()/sort_desc() (lowerSortOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp) and the date-component family (lowerDateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp) — into this single shared helper, which is now the guard's only construction site. The underlying claim is unchanged from each of those three composers' own former rationale (histogram_native_mixed_or_sort.go's own identical check, cerberus issue #2605, and its siblings #2346/#2595/#2600/#2609/#2611): every caller reaches this guard only via shadowResolveMixedExpHistogramOperands with a `b` that dateFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp / scalarArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp / sortOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp matched through mixedExpHistogramSetOp, which requires b.Op == parser.LOR — `or` is a set operator, never a comparison, so the parser can never have set ReturnBool on it, regardless of which of the three callers reached this now-shared check.
